Six Delve attributes and Border talents appear in Skills. Defeat corrupted enemies and harvest Ember Salts. Host console: delve status; delve boss. This prototype uses vanilla terrain and models. labels.delveForestReadinessGuideDesc: Forest recipes use crafting proficiency 1-20, independent of character level. Gather wood, stone, grass, clay and marked iron/nitrate. Craft a stone axe, shovel, bedroll, frames, storage, doors and spikes. Build a Field Hearth, Forest Forge and Rain Collector; make charcoal, jars, water, cloth and repairs. Native Forest stumps guarantee honey. Gardens supply crop seeds; wildlife supplies meat, hides and bone. At proficiency 10 make processing benches; at 20 forge upgraded weapons, armor and tools and inscribe etched runes. Alternate stone arrows/bolts use fiber instead of feathers. Later-biome/native recipes outside this catalogue are unavailable in this playtest. Read START-HERE.txt for full routes and horde preparation.
